# highcharter

Highcharter brings Highcharts to R. Turn data frames, time series and
statistical results into interactive visualizations, explore geographic
data and create financial charts with a flexible R interface.

## Installation

Install from CRAN:

``` r

install.packages("highcharter")
```

Or install the development version from GitHub:

``` r

remotes::install_github("jbkunst/highcharter")
```

## What’s included

One Highcharts bundle brings together Charts, Stock, Maps and Gantt.
Choose from dozens of chart types and combine them with tooltips, zoom,
drilldown, annotations, exporting and accessibility features.

- Chart R objects with
  [`hchart()`](https://jkunst.com/highcharter/reference/hchart.md): data
  frames, vectors, time series, forecasts and survival models all have a
  starting point.
- Create choropleths with
  [`hcmap()`](https://jkunst.com/highcharter/reference/hcmap.md) and
  bring your own geographic data.
- Explore financial time series and candlesticks with
  [`highchartstock()`](https://jkunst.com/highcharter/reference/highchartstock.md),
  technical indicators and Stock Tools.
- Make charts your own with themes, colors, labels and languages.
- Add interactive charts to Shiny applications and R Markdown documents.

## Where to start

- [First steps](https://jkunst.com/highcharter/articles/first-steps.md):
  create your first chart from a data frame.
- [`hchart()` guide](https://jkunst.com/highcharter/articles/hchart.md):
  chart time series, forecasts and other R objects.
- [Showcase](https://jkunst.com/highcharter/articles/showcase.md):
  discover ideas for customization and chart design.
- [Chart types](https://jkunst.com/highcharter/articles/chart-types.md):
  find a chart type and its R example.
- [Maps](https://jkunst.com/highcharter/articles/maps.md) and [Stock
  charts and Stock
  Tools](https://jkunst.com/highcharter/articles/stock.md): explore
  places and financial time series.
- [Shiny](https://jkunst.com/highcharter/articles/shiny.md) and
  [accessibility](https://jkunst.com/highcharter/articles/accessibility.md):
  build interactive experiences for your audience.
- [Function
  reference](https://jkunst.com/highcharter/reference/index.md): look up
  helpers and chart options.
- [Highcharts API in
  R](https://jkunst.com/highcharter/articles/highcharts-api.md) and
  [JavaScript-to-R
  guide](https://jkunst.com/highcharter/articles/highchartsjs-api-basics.md):
  learn how Highcharts options translate to R code.

## Licensing

The R wrapper in `highcharter` is licensed under MIT. Every chart
created with `highcharter` uses the bundled Highcharts JavaScript
library. Your use of Highcharts must be covered by the applicable
Highsoft terms for [commercial use](https://shop.highcharts.com/license)
or [personal and educational
use](https://shop.highcharts.com/license-eula).

[Source code](https://github.com/jbkunst/highcharter) · [Report an
issue](https://github.com/jbkunst/highcharter/issues) ·
[Contribute](https://jkunst.com/highcharter/CONTRIBUTING.md) · [Authors
and citation](https://jkunst.com/highcharter/authors.md)

# Package index

## Create a chart

- [`hchart()`](https://jkunst.com/highcharter/reference/hchart.md) :
  Create a highchart object from a particular data type
- [`highchart()`](https://jkunst.com/highcharter/reference/highchart.md)
  : Create a Highcharts chart widget
- [`highchartstock()`](https://jkunst.com/highcharter/reference/highchartstock.md)
  : Create a Highcharts Stock widget with Stock Tools

## Add data and series

Map R columns to point fields with hcaes(), then add series to a chart.

- [`hcaes()`](https://jkunst.com/highcharter/reference/hcaes.md) : Map
  data-frame columns to Highcharts point options
- [`hcaes_string()`](https://jkunst.com/highcharter/reference/hcaes_string.md)
  : Map point options using strings
- [`hc_add_series()`](https://jkunst.com/highcharter/reference/hc_add_series.md)
  : Adding data to highchart objects
- [`hc_add_series_list()`](https://jkunst.com/highcharter/reference/hc_add_series_list.md)
  : Shortcut for data series from a list of data series

- [`hcpxy_set_data()`](https://jkunst.com/highcharter/reference/hcpxy_set_data.md)
  : Update data for a higchartProxy object
- [`hcpxy_set_extremes()`](https://jkunst.com/highcharter/reference/hcpxy_set_extremes.md)
  : Set axis extremes for a higchartProxy object
- [`hcpxy_update()`](https://jkunst.com/highcharter/reference/hcpxy_update.md)
  : Update options for a higchartProxy object
- [`hcpxy_update_point()`](https://jkunst.com/highcharter/reference/hcpxy_update_point.md)

- [`hcpxy_update_series()`](https://jkunst.com/highcharter/reference/hcpxy_update_series.md)

## Methods for R objects

These methods are selected automatically by hchart() and
hc_add_series().

- [`hchart(`*`<randomForest>`*`)`](https://jkunst.com/highcharter/reference/hchart.randomForest.md)
  : Chart the out-of-bag error of a random forest

- [`hchart(`*`<cv.glmnet>`*`)`](https://jkunst.com/highcharter/reference/hchart.cv.glmnet.md)
  : Chart cross-validation for a regularization path

- [`hchart(`*`<xgb.Booster>`*`)`](https://jkunst.com/highcharter/reference/hchart.xgb.Booster.md)
  : Explore one boosted tree

- [`hchart(`*`<hclust>`*`)`](https://jkunst.com/highcharter/reference/hchart.hclust.md)
  [`hchart(`*`<dendrogram>`*`)`](https://jkunst.com/highcharter/reference/hchart.hclust.md)
  [`hchart(`*`<phylo>`*`)`](https://jkunst.com/highcharter/reference/hchart.hclust.md)
  : Draw a cluster dendrogram or a phylogeny

- [`hchart(`*`<constparty>`*`)`](https://jkunst.com/highcharter/reference/hchart.constparty.md)
  [`hchart(`*`<rpart>`*`)`](https://jkunst.com/highcharter/reference/hchart.constparty.md)
  [`hchart(`*`<C5.0>`*`)`](https://jkunst.com/highcharter/reference/hchart.constparty.md)
  : Chart a fitted decision tree

- [`hchart(`*`<igraph>`*`)`](https://jkunst.com/highcharter/reference/hchart.igraph.md)
  : Plot igraph objects using Highcharts

- [`hchart(`*`<survfit>`*`)`](https://jkunst.com/highcharter/reference/hchart.survfit.md)
  : Plot survival curves using Highcharts

- [`hc_add_series(`*`<character>`*`)`](https://jkunst.com/highcharter/reference/hc_add_series.character.md)
  [`hc_add_series(`*`<factor>`*`)`](https://jkunst.com/highcharter/reference/hc_add_series.character.md)
  : hc_add_series for character and factor objects

- [`hc_add_series(`*`<data.frame>`*`)`](https://jkunst.com/highcharter/reference/hc_add_series.data.frame.md)
  : hc_add_series for data frames objects

- [`hc_add_series(`*`<density>`*`)`](https://jkunst.com/highcharter/reference/hc_add_series.density.md)
  : hc_add_series for density objects

- [`hc_add_series(`*`<forecast>`*`)`](https://jkunst.com/highcharter/reference/hc_add_series.forecast.md)
  : hc_add_series for forecast objects

- [`hc_add_series(`*`<geo_json>`*`)`](https://jkunst.com/highcharter/reference/hc_add_series.geo_json.md)
  [`hc_add_series(`*`<geo_list>`*`)`](https://jkunst.com/highcharter/reference/hc_add_series.geo_json.md)
  : hc_add_series for geo_json & geo_list objects

- [`hc_add_series(`*`<lm>`*`)`](https://jkunst.com/highcharter/reference/hc_add_series.lm.md)
  [`hc_add_series(`*`<loess>`*`)`](https://jkunst.com/highcharter/reference/hc_add_series.lm.md)
  : Add a fitted model series (deprecated)

- [`hc_add_series(`*`<numeric>`*`)`](https://jkunst.com/highcharter/reference/hc_add_series.numeric.md)
  :

  `hc_add_series` for numeric objects

- [`hc_add_series(`*`<ts>`*`)`](https://jkunst.com/highcharter/reference/hc_add_series.ts.md)
  : hc_add_series for time series objects

- [`hc_add_series(`*`<xts>`*`)`](https://jkunst.com/highcharter/reference/hc_add_series.xts.md)
  [`hc_add_series(`*`<ohlc>`*`)`](https://jkunst.com/highcharter/reference/hc_add_series.xts.md)
  : Add xts series to a chart

- [`hc_add_series_list()`](https://jkunst.com/highcharter/reference/hc_add_series_list.md)
  : Shortcut for data series from a list of data series

- [`hc_add_series_map()`](https://jkunst.com/highcharter/reference/hc_add_series_map.md)
  : Add a map series

## Deprecated

- [`hc_yAxis_multiples()`](https://jkunst.com/highcharter/reference/hc_yAxis_multiples.md)
  : Compatibility alias for multiple y axes

# Articles

### Get started

- [Highcharter](https://jkunst.com/highcharter/articles/highcharter.md):

- [First steps on highcharter
  package](https://jkunst.com/highcharter/articles/first-steps.md):

  Start here if this is your first time with highcharter. You’ll learn
  the main functions to get a chart from a data frame and some basic
  examples.

- [hchart Function](https://jkunst.com/highcharter/articles/hchart.md):

  Use hchart() to plot R objects, from data frames and time series to
  fitted models, trees and networks.

- [Prepare chart data with data
  helpers](https://jkunst.com/highcharter/articles/data-helpers.md):

  Turn observations into series, links, hierarchy nodes or annotation
  labels.

### Explore charts

- [Chart types](https://jkunst.com/highcharter/articles/chart-types.md):

- [Maps](https://jkunst.com/highcharter/articles/maps.md):

- [Stock charts and Stock
  Tools](https://jkunst.com/highcharter/articles/stock.md):

- [Showcase](https://jkunst.com/highcharter/articles/showcase.md):

  In this vignette we’ll review some examples to show what highcharts
  and highcharter can do in terms of customization and design.

### Configure and interact

- [Highcharts
  API](https://jkunst.com/highcharter/articles/highcharts-api.md):

  Highcharts have a rich API which allows you to have control of the
  entire chart, from title, subtitle to axis ticks, labels, annotations.
  We’ll review the main functions with simple examples.

- [Javascript API
  Basics](https://jkunst.com/highcharter/articles/highchartsjs-api-basics.md):

  It’s very constructive to understand the relationship between the
  functions available in highcharter and the underlying highchartsJS API
  in more detail.

- [Chart themes](https://jkunst.com/highcharter/articles/themes.md):

  Use a preset, build a theme in R, or inherit the typography and colors
  of a Bootstrap page.

- [Accessible
  charts](https://jkunst.com/highcharter/articles/accessibility.md):

### Extensions and examples

- [From data to
  charts](https://jkunst.com/highcharter/articles/from-data-to-charts.md):

  Recreate the homepage’s international data and four charts in R, from
  World Bank indicators to scatter plots, exports, maps and shares.

- [Multiple
  axes](https://jkunst.com/highcharter/articles/multiple-axes.md):

  Arrange nine scatter plots in one chart using separate pairs of axes.

- [Connected
  charts](https://jkunst.com/highcharter/articles/connected-charts.md):

  Link tooltips, zoom and legends across separate highcharter widgets,
  and arrange four connected charts on one page.

- [Drilldown](https://jkunst.com/highcharter/articles/drilldown.md):

  Drilldown is the concept of inspecting increasingly high resolution
  data through clicking on chart items like columns, points or pie
  slices. Let’s see some *How tos* use this feature.

- [Modules &
  plugins](https://jkunst.com/highcharter/articles/modules.md):

  There are many plugins for highcharts created by both the Highsoft
  team and the community. The plugins can from adding features to series
  or legends, as well as in data export formats or adjusting regressions
  or smoothing.
